sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [D]Day by day, and with each passing [Em]moment,
Strength I [A]find to meet my trials [D]here;
I've no [A]cause for worry or for [D]fear.
[D]He, whose heart is kind beyond all [Em]measure,
Gives unto each [A]day what He deems [D]best,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [D]Every day, the Lord [Em]Himself is near me
[D]All my cares He fain [Em]would bear, and cheer me,
[A]Is a charge that [D]on Himself He laid;
[Bm]As your days, [D7]your strength shall [Em]be in measure,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [D]Help me, Lord, when [Em]toil and trouble meeting,
[A]E'er to take, as [D]from a father's hand,
